body.text: Scam ads selling a "national concealed carry permit" that does not exist have spent more than $3.1 million on Facebook and Instagram, and they are aimed at seniors and veterans.

An ISD report found 22 Meta pages pushing fake online carry permits, with at least 24.8 million impressions, AI likenesses of officials and fear-based hooks. There is no national permit; this is a scam-awareness and ad-hygiene moment for RTB.
